'''1997 Tatooine Regionals (Phoenix)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Tatooine region (New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Colorado).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Tatooine)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]<ref name="cc-update">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/cloudsupdate.html Star Wars CCG Cloud City Update], Rich Loftus, Decipher NewsFlash (2 July 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19971212060904/http://www.decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/cloudsupdate.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cc-egg">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/ccityeggcontest.html Cloud City Easter Egg Contest!], Tom Lischke, Decipher NewsFlash (5 November 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980223163152/http://www.decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/ccityeggcontest.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dec-news98">[http://decipher.com/newsandhighlights/index.html Decipher NewsFlash] (index; item "Revisit the Cloud City Articles", 5 January 1998: "Cloud City has been quite a success since its November release"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980110221528/http://decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jp-street">[http://decipher.com/newsandhighlights/jpreleasedate.htm Jabba's Palace In Stores Tomorrow], Rich Loftus, Decipher NewsFlash (28 April 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980506103233/http://decipher.com:80/newsandhighlights/jpreleasedate.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' 1 November 1997
* '''Site:''' Arizona Star Wars Con, Phoenix, Arizona
